## Checklist

- [ ] The entry links to the primary source (official site or the repository where development takes place).
- [ ] The description is one line, states what the resource does, and ends with a period.
- [ ] Names, authors, years, and venues were checked against the official source.
- [ ] The entry is not a duplicate of an existing one.
- [ ] `npx awesome-lint` passes locally.
